# Triage Fixture

## Originating Finding

A reviewer reports that a proposed record may overlap an existing authority, but the
available files do not establish whether the existing record's owner still consumes that
section.

## Expected Triage

Classify the finding as `unresolved`, record the inspected evidence and remaining factual
question in the governing pull request, and identify the exact repository-owner decision
needed. The triage reviewer must not be the originating reviewer, change author, or
implementation agent. Do not force a true-positive or false-positive result and do not
close the finding without recorded owner disposition and rationale.
